## Decorator Mode - Package Level always - Override in Struct Level

Firstly, let set up an empty golang project without any dependency.

```go.mod
module github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/decorator

go 1.25
```

Given that you have 4 structs in your source code:

```go
// file: code.go
//go:generate go run github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/cmd/generator

package decorator

type User struct {
	ID   string
	Name string
}

type UserEntity struct {
	ID    string
	Email string
}

type UserMessage struct {
	ID   string
	Name string
}

type UserResponse struct {
	ID    string
	Email string
}
```

### mode types (default)

#### single mappable entity, override to adaptive

```pkl
packages {
	["github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/decorator"] {
		decorator_mode = "always"
		source_pkg = "{CurrentPackage}"

		structs {
			["User"] { 
				source_struct_name = "UserMessage"
				decorator_mode = "adaptive"
			}
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// golden-file: gen_mapper.go
// Code generated by github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen - test, DO NOT EDIT.

package decorator

type iMapper interface {
	// ToUser converts a UserMessage value into a User value.
	ToUser(in UserMessage) User

	// FromUser converts a User value into a UserMessage value.
	FromUser(in User) UserMessage
}

func new_iMapper() iMapper {
	return &iMapperImpl{}
}

type iMapperImpl struct{}

func (m *iMapperImpl) ToUser(in UserMessage) User {
	var out User

	out.ID = in.ID
	out.Name = in.Name

	return out
}

func (m *iMapperImpl) FromUser(in User) UserMessage {
	var out UserMessage

	out.ID = in.ID
	out.Name = in.Name

	return out
}

var _ iMapper = (*iMapperImpl)(nil)
```

#### unmappable entities, override to never single struct

With unmappable entity in the list, decorator should not be emitted in only the unmappable struct

```pkl
packages {
	["github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen/decorator"] {
		decorator_mode = "always"
		source_pkg = "{CurrentPackage}"

		structs {
			["User"] { 
				source_struct_name = "UserEntity"
				decorator_mode = "never"
			}
			["UserMessage"] { source_struct_name = "UserResponse" }
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// golden-file: gen_mapper.go
// Code generated by github.com/toniphan21/go-mapper-gen - test, DO NOT EDIT.

package decorator

type iMapper interface {
	// ToUser converts a UserEntity value into a User value.
	ToUser(in UserEntity) User

	// FromUser converts a User value into a UserEntity value.
	FromUser(in User) UserEntity

	// ToUserMessage converts a UserResponse value into a UserMessage value.
	ToUserMessage(in UserResponse) UserMessage

	// FromUserMessage converts a UserMessage value into a UserResponse value.
	FromUserMessage(in UserMessage) UserResponse
}

type iMapperDecorator interface {
	decorateToUserMessage(in *UserResponse, out *UserMessage)

	decorateFromUserMessage(in *UserMessage, out *UserResponse)
}

func new_iMapper(decorator iMapperDecorator) iMapper {
	return &iMapperImpl{decorator: decorator}
}

type iMapperImpl struct {
	decorator iMapperDecorator
}

func (m *iMapperImpl) ToUser(in UserEntity) User {
	var out User

	out.ID = in.ID

	// Fields that could not be mapped:
	// out.Name =

	return out
}

func (m *iMapperImpl) FromUser(in User) UserEntity {
	var out UserEntity

	out.ID = in.ID

	// Fields that could not be mapped:
	// out.Email =

	return out
}

func (m *iMapperImpl) ToUserMessage(in UserResponse) UserMessage {
	var out UserMessage

	out.ID = in.ID

	if m.decorator != nil {
		m.decorator.decorateToUserMessage(&in, &out)
	}

	return out
}

func (m *iMapperImpl) FromUserMessage(in UserMessage) UserResponse {
	var out UserResponse

	out.ID = in.ID

	if m.decorator != nil {
		m.decorator.decorateFromUserMessage(&in, &out)
	}

	return out
}

type iMapperDecoratorNoOp struct{}

func (d *iMapperDecoratorNoOp) decorateToUserMessage(in *UserResponse, out *UserMessage) {
	// Fields that could not be mapped:
	// out.Name =
}

func (d *iMapperDecoratorNoOp) decorateFromUserMessage(in *UserMessage, out *UserResponse) {
	// Fields that could not be mapped:
	// out.Email =
}

var _ iMapper = (*iMapperImpl)(nil)
var _ iMapperDecorator = (*iMapperDecoratorNoOp)(nil)
```
